Long Weekend, short run? The show lasted just six weeks

“It’s my first ever radio show”, Karl Stefanovic says, almost bashfully, to the dozen or so audience members within earshot, seconds before coming back on air for the third hour of The Long Weekend.

Stefanovic and Eddie McGuire’s new Friday afternoon send off to the working week is going out live on Gold FM from ARN’s North Sydney studios.

The breakfast star is correct: he has done two decades of live TV, had a recent successful run at the one-on-one vodcast interview format, but has never anchored a live radio show.

Stefanovic’s nervous admission is only slightly undercut by the fact he was wearing a pair of ugg boots. It takes a man accustomed to a certain level of workplace comfort to wear uggs to his first day at a new job.

Nathan Jolly is the Features Editor at Mumbrella. He joined the team in July, 2023.

Consistency is always a winner on radio. You tune into smooth and you know what you’ll get – music mixed with some music and a dahs of music. You tune into Gold at midday on Friday and you get hours of middle aged men talking about sport, the old days and 80s pubs. I felt so old and switched stations.

Didn’t he host drive on 2GB back in 2019 for Steve Price for a while?

What station is the Gold network on in Perth please?

Hi Richard – 96FM is the Gold station in Perth. It should carry Karl and Eddie.
